'''Sidon''' was a village in [[Ghealdan]]. It was located on the banks of the [[River Boern]].

==Activities==
[[Rand al'Thor]] passed though the village on his way to [[Tear]]. When [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Loial]] follow him through the area, they find that the village was burned to the ground.{{ref/book|3|33}}
